speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have sudden-onset lower abdominal pain; to help me diagnose this, have you noticed if the pain is on the right or left side, and does it radiate to your groin or shoulder?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Epididymo-orchitis (highly suspicious given age, unprotected sex, and sudden onset pain; testicular torsion must also be ruled out immediately with imaging).

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine_Culture
REQUEST IMAGES: Scrotal_Ultrasound_with_Doppler
